capabilities: Navigate back and forward through per-pane snapshots of cursor and scroll positions
Capture same-file jumps via internal, heading, and block links and outline clicks
Record jumps into and out of the graph view so they stay undoable
Persist history across restarts, tied to each pane
Expose Go back / Go forward commands for user-assigned hotkeys
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; it can also be installed as a beta plugin via BRAT.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's built-in back/forward only steps between files.
problem: Obsidian's built-in back/forward navigation only steps between files, so returning from a jump loses the exact cursor position and scroll offset you left.
summary: Navigation history plugin that adds back/forward commands restoring exact cursor and scroll positions, including jumps within a single note.
